# CodeBlock

A read-only block of code (GAP-216, decision 225): MAP-619's merged unit shows a custom field's JSON in one. The code is in the mono family (Semantics / Typography / Family / Mono), 14/20 in the foreground, on the muted surface (background 100), on the control radius, 12 inside. There is no syntax colouring: the code is plain text, shown as written, every space and line kept, and it can be selected.

- **Import:** `import { CodeBlock } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-codeblock--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { CodeBlock, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const MERGED_UNIT = `{
  "mergedUnit": {
    "fid": "f-1209",
    "name": "Bean & Leaf Café",
    "sources": ["f-1042", "f-1043"],
    "mergedAt": "2026-10-29T09:41:00Z",
    "geometry": { "type": "Polygon", "levels": [1] }
  }
}`;

export function CodeBlockExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 480 }}>
        <CodeBlock label="mergedUnit JSON" code={MERGED_UNIT} copyable />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## CodeBlock

A read-only block of code (GAP-216, decision 225): the code in the mono
family, on the muted surface, wrapped or scrolling sideways, with an
optional copy that says it copied. MAP-619's merged unit shows a custom
field's JSON in one. No syntax colouring: the code is plain text.

A region named by `label`, holding a `<pre>` and its `<code>`.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `CodeBlockProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children" | "onCopy">`.

- `code`: `string`, **required**.

  The code, shown as written: every space and line kept, no colouring.

- `label`: `string`, **required**.

  The region's name, what a screen reader says it is: "mergedUnit JSON".
  The product's words, in its own language.

- `wrap`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.

  Long lines wrap (the default). `false` keeps each line whole and
  scrolls the block sideways; the scroller is then reachable from the
  keyboard, so its overflow can be read with the arrow keys.

- `maxHeight`: `number | string`, optional.

  The block's tallest, a number of pixels or any CSS length ("12rem"), so
  a long value never pushes the page: past it the code scrolls inside the
  block, and the scroller is reachable from the keyboard. Unset, the
  block is as tall as its code.

- `copyable`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  A copy button at the block's top end. Off by default.

- `copyLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Copy"`.

  The copy button's name. Default "Copy".

- `copiedLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Copied"`.

  What is announced once the code is copied. Default "Copied".

- `onCopy`: `(code: string) => void`, optional.

  Called with the code once it is copied.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
